release_gates: Package the collected license texts and relevant copyright/attribution notices with the distributed runtime; no NOTICE-only label should imply license texts are optional.

Review Eigen MPL-2.0 sections 3.1-3.3, supply required source availability information for covered Eigen code, and preserve exact source/modification records. This audit does not decide product-level legal compliance.

Confirm exact ONNX Runtime vendor binary build provenance/SBOM and notice coverage; Microsoft source notices do not prove which optional third-party components are present in the csukuangfj prebuilt archive.
Keep disabled test/example/benchmark/provider paths off in a clean cache; source overrides bypass FetchContent archive verification, so validate archives before extraction.
Preserve pristine simple-sentencepiece sources and record the deterministic upstream Android configuration modifications before distributing modified sources.
Reconcile nlohmann JSON embedded Hedley and Abseil attribution evidence before finalizing public notice wording.
After a real Android build, inspect selected link dependencies, JNI exports, packaged .so files and any NDK libc++ runtime; this static audit does not verify the resulting binary contents.
Review the actual ASR/VAD/tokenizer model licenses separately; they are not covered by native source-code licenses.

verification.method: Downloaded official project/selected maintainer-fork archives and matched each complete archive against the SHA-256 literal in the effective CMake declaration; inspected nested CMake files and actual license/notice text. ONNX Runtime vendor archive independently rehashed; Microsoft upstream notices separately fetched at resolved tag commit.
verification.caveat: The active graph is a static source inference for a clean cache and the stated OFF options. It is not a full binary SBOM and does not attest the transitive build contents of prebuilt ONNX Runtime.
